newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says production at Khorasan gas refinery up.
newsitem.headline: Iran says production at Khorasan gas refinery up.

text.p: The daily production capacity of the Hasheminejad gas refinery in northeastern Iran has reached 25 million cubic metres (880 million cubic feet), a National Gas Co official said in remarks published on Wednesday.

Abdolhossein Samari, refining and transportation operations manager at the National Gas Co, was quoted by the daily Resalat as saying production at the refinery in Sarakhs, Korasan province, was exceeding the nominal capacity of 21 million cubic metres (740 million cubic feet) a day.
"He said that since last year, a daily production capacity of 25 million cubic metres had been realised and a further 25 percent increase in capacity was forecast for this year," the paper said.
Iran has the world's second largest gas reserves after Russia. STR cmd
